utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus—that keeps it simple. If anyone asks, have them bring just one of those items so we don’t end up with duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Eli—I’ll tell folks we still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, or a small step stool, and to bring just one thing they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus—that’s clear enough. Keep telling folks it’s just the screwdrivers, a hammer, or a small step stool, and only one item each so we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Jules, I’m pretty sure it’s still by the community shed at the usual time, mid-morning or so. I’ll bring that spare screwdriver set if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Oren—thanks. I’m checking what tools and volunteers are still missing, so if you hear anything else from around your side, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I will; I haven’t heard anything new yet, but if Ira passes along an update I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—before I pass anything along, can we check with Eli to confirm the drop-off spot, whether it’s definitely this weekend, and who’s actually handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please check with Eli first—I only know it’s for small repairs, they still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and I don’t want to promise a drop-off spot, pickups, or this weekend until he confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll hold off telling anyone it’s this weekend or that pickups are set until Eli confirms the drop-off spot, schedule, and who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that folks might be bringing things to the hall already—have they started collecting supplies yet, or is the shed still the main spot?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The shed’s still the main spot, as far as I know, and I’ll be there early Saturday with the tables, signage, signup sheet, and donation box. Are you still bringing that spare screwdriver set over?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—thanks for clearing that up. I don’t have the screwdriver set myself, but I can swing by the shed Saturday and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still in for Saturday at the shed—just text me the time, and I can bring a hammer or a step stool if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo—I still haven’t heard the exact time, but I’ll text you as soon as it’s confirmed, and a hammer or step stool would both help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—just shoot me the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring the hammer unless you’d rather I grab the step stool.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and bottled water in decent shape, but we’re still short on work lights for the repair drive. I’m asking around the block now and I’ll text you the count once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on the final repair list and pickup confirmation, so send me the work-light count when you have it and I’ll fold it into one clean update for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — tape, gloves, and water are in decent shape, so I’m just chasing down the work-light count now and I’ll text you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and we’re still looking for a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool. If you can help spread the word or bring one easy-to-carry item, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Rosa—got it. I can spread the word and probably bring a screwdriver unless I hear they still need something more specific first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Dane—thank you. Please keep sharing that it’s Sunday at the community center, and if a screwdriver still works for you, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik—I really appreciate you keeping the word out. I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the exact time, place, and repair details, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Sam—I’ll keep telling people the repair drive is coming up, and once you hear the exact time and place, I’ll pass that around too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik—that really helps. As soon as the organizers confirm the time, place, and repair details, I’ll send them straight over to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Uli, have you heard the latest sign-up count for the repair drive, and do they still need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t heard the latest count, no. We were focused on the shed roof leak, and a few basic tools—especially easy-to-carry ones—still help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I’ll chase the count with Sam then—what easy-to-carry tools do they still need most?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time and drop-off spot, Rey, but I’m keeping track and will pass the location along as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the repair list and whether Malik’s definitely doing pickups too, so I’ll keep it quiet until we’ve got one clean update.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That makes sense, Rey—I'm noting it all in one place, and once Rosa confirms the time and drop-off spot, we can bundle it with Faye’s repair list and Malik’s pickup status in one clean update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—that helps. I’ll aim for mid-morning after drop-off, and I’m still trying to confirm the repair list and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mid-morning works—send the repair list and pickup update when you’ve got them, and I’ll plan around that after the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’ll message you as soon as I’ve confirmed the repair list and whether Malik’s definitely got pickups covered.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we get a clear confirmation from Ira first? I’d rather not commit to the weekend until the timing and drop-off details are actually locked in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fair enough—last I heard from Rosa, it’s Sunday at the community center and folks should only bring easy-to-carry tools, but I’ll keep nudging for a firm confirmation from Ira before I spread it any further.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—can you just check with Ira directly and make sure Sunday at the community center is actually locked before I put my name down?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and bottled water covered pretty well, but we’re still short on work lights for the repair drive. I’m asking around the block now and I’ll text you the count once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. I can lend a couple work lights if the count still comes up short, so text me once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d help a lot, Gus—thanks. I’m still checking around, and I’ll text you the count as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Still waiting on the latest from the organizers, Leo, but I’m keeping my ear out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything solid about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll start on the shed roof, then head over for the simple fixes once you send the spot and tool list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Leo—I’ll send the location and tool list the minute I hear, and I’m still nudging folks so we’ve got enough hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time and drop-off spot, Faye, and as soon as I have it I’ll share the location with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — mid-morning after school drop-off still works for me, and once Rosa confirms, can you also remind me whether we’re still just doing small household fixes and bike repairs and if Malik’s definitely handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—right now we’re still planning on small household fixes and bike repairs, and I’m waiting on final word before I confirm Malik’s pickup role along with the exact spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mina, I’m hearing the repair drive still needs a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and folks should only bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—do you know the latest sign-up count too, or is Sam still the one I should check with?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the latest count myself, so Sam’s probably still the best one to check with—but if you learn anything else they still need, tell me and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I still don’t have the final list, drop-off spot, or Malik’s pickup confirmation yet. Best to keep waiting on Faye so you can send one clean update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll hold off inviting more folks until Faye confirms the repair list, drop-off spot, and Malik’s pickups so I can send one clear update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s still the safest move—I haven’t heard anything new yet, so let’s wait for Faye before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Oren—it’s by the community shed at ten, and I can help sort tools once we’re there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Dane. Ten by the community shed, then; I’ll try to remember my spare screwdriver set too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great—if you bring that set, I’ll start sorting whatever’s there when we get to the shed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Noah, but it sounds like folks are already getting organized. I’m thinking I’ll stop by the hall and ask what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I probably missed the latest update too—are they still meeting by the community shed this Saturday, and what time was it again?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s what I’d heard second-hand too—community shed on Saturday at the usual time, I think, but I was going to check at the hall just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—looks like we still need a couple screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool. Just text me the time and I’ll bring what I can carry.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we hold off on committing until Ira confirms the time and drop-off spot? I just want to be sure this weekend is actually locked in first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, fair enough—once Ira confirms the time and spot, send it over and I’ll figure out what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I pass this along, can you confirm it’s definitely this weekend, which repairs the drive is covering, who finalized the schedule, and whether Malik’s handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can’t confirm all that yet—I’m still waiting on the organizers to lock in the exact time, place, repair list, and whether Malik’s definitely covering pickups, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please check with the organizers and let me know once the weekend timing, repair list, schedule lead, and Malik’s pickup role are all confirmed before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Mara — I heard you might be bringing extension cords; do you know what basic hand tools are still missing so I can pass it along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — extension cords would help, and I know we still need a spare screwdriver set at the community shed. I’ll be there early Saturday with the tables, signage, signup sheet, and donation box.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Mara — I’ll let folks know you’ve got the cords covered and that a spare screwdriver set is still needed at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Pia, I’m still bringing the screwdriver set, but I should mention I heard it may have shifted to Sunday at the community center, so I’m trying to confirm before I promise the shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli—that’s exactly why I don’t want us promising the shed yet; until Eli confirms Sunday and the community center as the drop-off spot, let’s just stick with the shared list of small tools and who can carry what themselves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, that makes sense—I’ll keep to the small tools list for now and wait for Eli to confirm. I’m a bit scattered today, so I’d rather not confuse anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate you keeping the word going. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send you the exact time as soon as I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s Sunday at the community center, and once you send the exact time I’ll make sure everyone hears that too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik—that takes a real load off. I’ll get the confirmed start time to you as soon as I have it so we can keep everyone aligned.
